units: <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 17:25">Targ. I Chr. XVII, 25</cite> <he>פ׳ דפומא</he> opening of the mouth, courage to speak; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 110a:16">Snh. 110ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 16:30">Num. XVI, 30</cite>) <he>לקרובי פ׳</he> the creation consisted only in bringing the gate (of Gehenna) nearer.—
<cite ref="Megillah 10b:3">Meg. 10ᵇ</cite>, sq., <he>פתח לה פ׳ להאי וכ׳</he> took his opening text for this (Purim) lesson from here.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:8">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>פתחין פ׳ להאי קרא</he> took as text the following verse; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Nedarim 22b:10">Ned. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>פתח פ׳ לנפשיה</he> offered himself a reason for absolution from his vow.
